## Purpose
Section card that lists external (non-GitHub) projects as clickable tiles with title, optional thumbnail and description. It shows skeleton tiles while loading and is composed by the page via [[src-components]].

## Key concepts
- `ExternalProjectCard({externalProjects, header, loading, googleAnalyticId})` renders a 1-2 column grid.
- Thumbnails use [[src-components-lazy-image]] with a skeleton placeholder.
- Click handler prevents default, fires `ga.event('Click External Project')` when an analytics id is set, then `window.open(link, '_blank')`. Types from [[src-interfaces]], helpers from [[src-utils]].

## Gotchas
- Prop is named `googleAnalyticId` here but `googleAnalyticsId` in [[src-components-github-project-card]] and [[src-components-head-tag-editor]].
- Skeleton count is `externalProjects.length`, so an empty list shows no skeletons while loading.
